components.label: Crop production, area and calendars
components.validation: Historical wheat test: observed-weather yield-scale candidate failed annual-skill checks (25 test years at one site, r=-0.378). Only2/25 recorded winter seasons fit current temperature/length rules. Prior physiological-clock candidate also failed. No AD200 yield default promoted.

components.next_test: Chronological crop transpiration/soil evaporation/drainage budget and winter-season compatibility, constrained by documented management. Broadbalk now development/spent; Woburn reserved until local weather matching. See reports/HISTORICAL_WHEAT_20261105.md.
